cleanIntro:
The Patrician is Weatherby's 12-gauge pump. A cross-bolt safety sits at the rear of the trigger guard, and a gold disconnector lever on the right of the receiver unlocks the forearm when the gun is cocked.

Weatherby's strip takes the barrel off forward and upward, then the forearm off the magazine tube with the bolt and carrier riding on its slide action bars. The locking block and the trigger assembly come out only in Deep Clean.

This guide follows Weatherby's own PATRICIAN instruction manual.

steps.title: Safety on: button pushed to the right
steps.action: Point the gun somewhere safe and keep your finger off the trigger. Push the safety button at the rear of the trigger guard through to the right. That is SAFE. Pushed fully to the left, a red band shows and the gun is ready to fire.
steps.quote: When pressed through the trigger guard to the right, the gun
steps.cite: Weatherby PATRICIAN pump shotgun instruction manual and warranty — UNKNOWN — no revision, document number or date is printed — Safety, p.9

steps.title: Cocked gun: disconnector lever forward to free the forearm
steps.action: If the gun is cocked, the forearm is locked and will not move. Push the gold disconnector lever on the right side of the receiver forward and the forearm comes free to move rearward.
steps.quote: If gun is cocked, move disconnector lever forward to permit forearm to move rearward.
steps.cite: Weatherby PATRICIAN pump shotgun instruction manual and warranty — UNKNOWN — no revision, document number or date is printed — TO DISASSEMBLE BOLT ASSEMBLY FOR CLEANING, p.3

steps.title: Pump it empty, round by round
steps.action: With the safety on SAFE, push the disconnector lever forward and move the forearm rearward. When the bolt is fully open the shell in the chamber ejects and the next round is released from the magazine tube. Roll the gun sideways so the released shell drops out of the ejection port, close the action by moving the forearm fully forward, and repeat until nothing more comes out.
steps.quote: When bolt is fully opened the shell in chamber will eject and the next round from magazine tube will be released.
steps.cite: Weatherby PATRICIAN pump shotgun instruction manual and warranty — UNKNOWN — no revision, document number or date is printed — TO UNLOAD, p.5

steps.title: Look: magazine and chamber both empty
steps.action: Look into the chamber and the magazine tube yourself, and feel the magazine tube with a finger past the shell latch. Nothing comes apart until both are empty.
steps.quote: CAUTION: Check magazine and chamber to be certain gun is empty.
steps.cite: Weatherby PATRICIAN pump shotgun instruction manual and warranty — UNKNOWN — no revision, document number or date is printed — TO UNLOAD, p.5

steps.title: Empty and on SAFE before anything comes off
steps.action: Make sure the gun is unloaded and the safety button is in the SAFE position before you start taking it apart.
steps.quote: Make sure gun is unloaded and safety button is in
steps.cite: Weatherby PATRICIAN pump shotgun instruction manual and warranty — UNKNOWN — no revision, document number or date is printed — TO DISASSEMBLE BARREL FROM GUN, p.5

steps.title: Forearm back until the bolt face is halfway open
steps.action: Move the forearm rearward until the bolt face sits about halfway back in the ejection port. This is the position the barrel comes off and goes back on in.
steps.quote: Move forearm rearward until bolt face is halfway open
steps.cite: Weatherby PATRICIAN pump shotgun instruction manual and warranty — UNKNOWN — no revision, document number or date is printed — TO DISASSEMBLE BARREL FROM GUN, p.5

steps.title: Magazine cap off, barrel forward and up
steps.action: Unscrew the magazine cap. Pull the barrel gently forward and upward until the barrel extension clears the front of the receiver, and lift it away.
steps.quote: Pull barrel gently forward and upward until barrel extension clears front of receiver.
steps.cite: Weatherby PATRICIAN pump shotgun instruction manual and warranty — UNKNOWN — no revision, document number or date is printed — TO DISASSEMBLE BARREL FROM GUN, p.5

steps.title: Forearm forward to its stop, lifter pressed up
steps.action: Hold the gun level and pull the forearm forward until it stops. Keep it there and press the lifter up with your right index finger or thumb.
steps.quote: While holding gun in this position, press lifter up with the right index finger or thumb
steps.cite: Weatherby PATRICIAN pump shotgun instruction manual and warranty — UNKNOWN — no revision, document number or date is printed — TO DISASSEMBLE BOLT ASSEMBLY FOR CLEANING, p.3

steps.title: ⛔ Gun right side up, then the shell latch on the LEFT
steps.action: Press the shell latch on the left side of the receiver, the side opposite the ejection port. The forearm then slides completely off the magazine tube and brings the bolt assembly out of the receiver with it.
steps.prose: ⛔ You may turn the gun over to find the latch, but turn it right side up again before you press it. Pressed upside down, the bolt assembly drops out.
steps.quote: make sure that gun is right side up before depressing latch and proceeding
steps.cite: Weatherby PATRICIAN pump shotgun instruction manual and warranty — UNKNOWN — no revision, document number or date is printed — TO DISASSEMBLE BOLT ASSEMBLY FOR CLEANING, p.3

steps.title: Field strip complete
steps.action: With the forearm assembly off the gun, lift the bolt and carrier, with the locking block in the bolt, off the slide action bars. That is Weatherby's strip for cleaning: barrel, magazine cap, forearm with its slide action bars, bolt and carrier, and the receiver.
steps.prose: Taking the locking block out of the bolt, and taking the trigger assembly out of the receiver, are in Deep Clean.
steps.quote: With forearm assembly removed from gun, locking block, bolt and carrier may be lifted from slide action bars
steps.cite: Weatherby PATRICIAN pump shotgun instruction manual and warranty — UNKNOWN — no revision, document number or date is printed — TO DISASSEMBLE BOLT ASSEMBLY FOR CLEANING, p.4

steps.title: Barrel clean and clear of obstructions
steps.action: Clean the barrel and look through it. Before it goes back on, it must be clean and free of any obstruction.
steps.quote: inspect barrel to make certain it is clean and free of obstructions.
steps.cite: Weatherby PATRICIAN pump shotgun instruction manual and warranty — UNKNOWN — no revision, document number or date is printed — Assembly, p.8

steps.title: Before firing: no grease or oil left in the bore or chamber
steps.action: Before you fire the gun, wipe all grease and oil out of the inside of the barrel and the chamber.
steps.quote: make sure all grease and oil is wiped from the inside of the barrel and chamber.
steps.cite: Weatherby PATRICIAN pump shotgun instruction manual and warranty — UNKNOWN — no revision, document number or date is printed — Cleaning, p.9

steps.title: After each use: every metal surface, inside and out
steps.action: After each use, clean all the metal surfaces of the gun, inside and out, and wipe them with an oily patch.
steps.quote: metal surfaces inside and out should be cleaned and wiped with an oily patch after each use.
steps.cite: Weatherby PATRICIAN pump shotgun instruction manual and warranty — UNKNOWN — no revision, document number or date is printed — Cleaning, p.9

steps.title: A light coat of oil only
steps.action: Oil the gun with a light coat only. Excess oil collects dust and burnt powder, and that build-up can make the gun malfunction.
steps.quote: excess oiling will cause an accumulation of dust and burnt powder
steps.cite: Weatherby PATRICIAN pump shotgun instruction manual and warranty — UNKNOWN — no revision, document number or date is printed — Cleaning, p.9

steps.title: Long storage: grease on the metal, nothing in the muzzle
steps.action: For long storage, put gun grease on all the metal parts and keep the gun somewhere dry. Do not plug the muzzle with grease or anything else.
steps.quote: Do not plug muzzle with grease or any other obstruction.
steps.cite: Weatherby PATRICIAN pump shotgun instruction manual and warranty — UNKNOWN — no revision, document number or date is printed — Cleaning, p.9

deepSteps.title: Bolt off the carrier, locking block out of the bolt
deepSteps.action: With the bolt and carrier off the slide action bars, lift the bolt from the carrier and take the locking block out of the bolt. Brush the parts with an evaporative solvent to clean them.
deepSteps.quote: bolt from carrier and remove locking block from bolt.
deepSteps.cite: Weatherby PATRICIAN pump shotgun instruction manual and warranty — UNKNOWN — no revision, document number or date is printed — TO DISASSEMBLE BOLT ASSEMBLY FOR CLEANING, p.4

deepSteps.title: Locking lug toward the front of the bolt
deepSteps.action: The locking block goes back with its locking lug toward the front of the bolt. The front of the bolt is the end with the firing pin and the extractor hook.
deepSteps.quote: locking lug on locking block must be toward front of bolt
deepSteps.cite: Weatherby PATRICIAN pump shotgun instruction manual and warranty — UNKNOWN — no revision, document number or date is printed — TO REASSEMBLE LOCKING BLOCK TO BOLT BODY, p.4

deepSteps.title: Front of the block into its recess, then the back down
deepSteps.action: Put the front of the locking block into the recess in the bolt body, then lower the back of the block into position. Placed right, the whole block drops into place in the bolt body.
deepSteps.quote: Place front of locking block into the recess in bolt body then lower back of locking block into position.
deepSteps.cite: Weatherby PATRICIAN pump shotgun instruction manual and warranty — UNKNOWN — no revision, document number or date is printed — TO REASSEMBLE LOCKING BLOCK TO BOLT BODY, p.4

deepSteps.title: Trigger assembly: safety on, gun cocked
deepSteps.action: Put the safety button on SAFE and cock the gun by pumping the action.
deepSteps.prose: Weatherby's trigger section starts from a gun that can be pumped. If the forearm and bolt are already off, put them back first (the reassembly list), or take the trigger out before the bolt assembly comes off.
deepSteps.cite: Weatherby PATRICIAN pump shotgun instruction manual and warranty — UNKNOWN — no revision, document number or date is printed — TO REMOVE TRIGGER, p.7

deepSteps.title: Two pins out from the left, with a punch
deepSteps.action: From the left side of the receiver, tap out the front trigger plate pin with a punch. Then tap out the disconnector lever pin.
deepSteps.quote: From left side of receiver tap out front trigger plate pin with a punch
deepSteps.cite: Weatherby PATRICIAN pump shotgun instruction manual and warranty — UNKNOWN — no revision, document number or date is printed — TO REMOVE TRIGGER, p.7

deepSteps.title: Trigger guard up, rear of the assembly lifted out
deepSteps.action: Turn the gun so the trigger guard faces up. Lift the rear of the trigger assembly out of the receiver until it is completely out.
deepSteps.quote: Lift rear of trigger assembly out of receiver until completely removed.
deepSteps.cite: Weatherby PATRICIAN pump shotgun instruction manual and warranty — UNKNOWN — no revision, document number or date is printed — TO REMOVE TRIGGER, p.7

deepSteps.title: Clean it as one unit, still cocked
deepSteps.action: Leave the trigger assembly cocked and clean it as a unit with solvent. Afterwards wipe it dry and re-oil it lightly. If the trigger gets pulled while you clean, press the hammer back to the cocked position.
deepSteps.prose: Weatherby's book goes no further: the trigger assembly is cleaned as a unit and not taken apart.
deepSteps.quote: Leave trigger in cocked position and clean as a unit with solvent.
deepSteps.cite: Weatherby PATRICIAN pump shotgun instruction manual and warranty — UNKNOWN — no revision, document number or date is printed — TO REMOVE TRIGGER, p.7

deepSteps.title: Front of the assembly in first, then the rear lowered
deepSteps.action: Put the front of the trigger assembly into the action first, then lower the rear of the assembly gently into the receiver.
deepSteps.quote: then lower rear of trigger assembly gently into receiver.
deepSteps.cite: Weatherby PATRICIAN pump shotgun instruction manual and warranty — UNKNOWN — no revision, document number or date is printed — TO REMOVE TRIGGER, p.7

deepSteps.title: Disconnector lever pin in by hand
deepSteps.action: Check the trigger assembly is aligned in the receiver, then push the disconnector lever pin in by hand. If it will not go in flush with the receiver, rotate the pin with the disconnector lever and keep pushing until it is fully seated.
deepSteps.quote: Pin can be pushed into position by hand.
deepSteps.cite: Weatherby PATRICIAN pump shotgun instruction manual and warranty — UNKNOWN — no revision, document number or date is printed — TO REMOVE TRIGGER, p.8

deepSteps.title: Front trigger plate pin back to its stop
deepSteps.action: Push the front trigger plate pin back in to its stop, lined up with the hole in the trigger assembly, and tap it with a hammer until it is fully reseated.
deepSteps.quote: Reinsert front trigger plate pin to stop.
deepSteps.cite: Weatherby PATRICIAN pump shotgun instruction manual and warranty — UNKNOWN — no revision, document number or date is printed — TO REMOVE TRIGGER, p.8

cleaning.name: BARREL AND CHAMBER
tasks: Barrel cleaned and looked through: clean and free of obstructions
Before firing: all grease and oil wiped out of the bore and chamber

cleaning.name: METAL SURFACES
tasks: Every metal surface cleaned, inside and out
Wiped with an oily patch after each use

cleaning.name: LUBRICATION
tasks: A light coat of oil only
Do not over-oil: excess collects dust and burnt powder

cleaning.name: STORAGE
tasks: Long storage: gun grease on all metal parts, kept dry
Do not plug the muzzle with grease or anything else

reassembly: Bolt body over the carrier, locking block already in it: the carrier's large flat surface toward the front of the bolt, its step toward the back.
Carrier and bolt into the grooves of the slide action bars, front of the bolt facing the front of the forearm.
Bolt lined up with the receiver, forearm pushed onto the magazine tube, then eased rearward until the bolt stops about halfway into the action.

Trigger guard up, one hand on the forearm: press the lifter fully down with the other index finger and, with a sideways motion of that finger, press the shell latch on the ejection-port side; ease the forearm back until it stops again.
Press the shell latch on the other side of the receiver and move the forearm rearward to its stop.
Disconnector lever forward, forearm rearward to open the action fully, then back to the halfway position for the barrel.
Barrel extension into the front of the receiver with the magazine ring guide lined up on the magazine tube; slide the barrel gently back until it butts solidly against the receiver.
Magazine cap screwed on finger tight.
fncheck: Prove it empty at the chamber and the magazine tube. Work the action through several times for free travel. Safety on SAFE (pushed to the right), trigger: nothing. With the gun cocked the forearm should stay locked until the disconnector lever is pushed forward. Before you load it, look through the barrel for any obstruction and wipe any grease or oil out of the bore and chamber. Guns marked PATRICIAN take 2 3/4-inch shells only and will not accept 3-inch shells; guns marked PATRICIAN II take 3-inch magnum shells as well. Carry only 12-gauge shells into the field.
